details: The United States and Iran have seen a renewed escalation in hostilities, with the US launching strikes against Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran retaliated by targeting US military bases in Jordan and the United Arab Emirates. Simultaneously, the US has initiated a new campaign of economic sanctions against Iran, aiming to further pressure its economy, which is reportedly in crisis. These actions have significantly driven up oil prices, with Brent crude rising above $90 per barrel, and contributed to global market uncertainty. France and the EU have condemned Iran's strikes and called for de-escalation, while also supporting economic pressure on Iran to curb its destabilizing activities.
title: US-Iran Conflict Escalates Amidst Sanctions and Strait of Hormuz Tensions

details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh indicated that further interest rate hikes might be necessary if inflation does not consistently return to the 2% target. This statement has heightened market expectations for a September rate hike, causing US Treasury yields to rise and putting pressure on equities. Such tightening monetary policy generally reduces liquidity and investor appetite for speculative assets, impacting cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed Signals Potential Rate Hikes, Pressuring Risk Assets

details: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping met on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit, where they reaffirmed strong Russia-China ties in what they described as an "unpredictable" world. This comes amidst ongoing global tensions and could signal further alignment between the two powers on international issues.
title: Russia and China Reaffirm Strategic Ties Amidst Global Instability

details: With Russia's new cryptocurrency regulations set to take effect on September 1, Sberbank, the country's largest lender, has predicted that regulated crypto trading volume on exchanges could reach 4 trillion rubles ($46.4 billion) in the first year. The bank also plans to offer loans secured by Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT once approved by the central bank. This move signifies growing institutional acceptance and a clearer regulatory framework in a major global economy.
title: Russia's Sberbank Forecasts Significant Crypto Trading Under New Regulations
